ending_commit_note: The final commit is supplied in the handoff because embedding its own hash would be self-referential; no post-commit mutation is permitted.
fixture_counting_method: Counts are explicit positive fixture rows and refusal rows in the repair-specific tests. Table rows are counted once per category; reused records can therefore appear in more than one positive category.
forbidden_actions_not_performed: No effect executor, process supervisor, model transport, policy engine, owner authorization, broker consumption, provider contact, benchmark, mint, witness operation, production installation, or V14–V18 action.
No historical or production evidence modification.

repair_findings.closure: CanonicalProposal now carries a closed typed ToolRequest union; each of list_files, read_file, write_file, and run_command has versioned request and result schemas with exact fields, strict types, path rules, bounds, effect classification, canonical result representation, and separate fingerprint domains.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: A proposal payload replacing the former read_file arguments with {"command":"rm -rf /","unexpected":true} is refused during typed deserialization.

repair_findings.closure: CanonicalProposal.create derives run, condition, model, transport, grammar, working-root, and scope bindings from one ExperimentSpecification and validate_for_specification checks every exact binding, including prompt content and request grammar fingerprint. EffectReservation derives and rechecks the specification executor and specification fingerprint.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: Proposals paired with changed run, condition, model, transport, prompt, grammar, working-root, or scope specifications, and reservations forged with a different executor, are refused.

repair_findings.closure: RECEIPT_STATE_MATRIX is exhaustive over all nine statuses and specifies reservation, six lifecycle booleans, process-exit policy, outcome knowledge, replay prohibition, and reconciliation requirement. EffectReceipt.validated enforces the matrix fail-closed.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: STARTED with started=false, COMPLETED without a required exit result, FAILED with executed_effect=true while not started, and AMBIGUOUS with completed=true are refused.

repair_findings.closure: ComparativeManifest.create requires typed DIRECT and GOVERNED TerminalManifest objects, validates each against the exact run and specification, requires distinct terminal fingerprints, and binds the exact parity report. Deserialization retains both typed terminal objects and validate_for_specifications performs typed reconciliation.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: The former same-DIRECT-terminal fixture is refused; swapped, unrelated-run, and other-specification terminals are also refused.

repair_findings.closure: TERMINAL_STATE_MATRIX defines ACCEPTED, REJECTED, INCONCLUSIVE, and NOT_EVALUATED. Final acceptance dispositions require complete reconciliation and INDEPENDENT_EVALUATOR; non-final dispositions require incomplete reconciliation.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: ACCEPTED with reconciliation_complete=false, REJECTED with reconciliation_complete=false, and completed reconciliation for INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_EVALUATED are refused.

schema_version_decision.future_runtime_rule: A runtime must adopt these exact version-1 definitions before persistence or issue a new ADR and consistently increment affected versions.
schema_version_decision.reason: M1 has no external or runtime persistence contract yet; the changed definitions are a pre-runtime correction and are regenerated together.
